title: Felony Bench
summary: Felony Bench is a web-based legal reference tool that helps users understand felony classifications, sentencing guidelines, and legal processes. The site gained significant traction on Hacker News, indicating strong interest from the tech community in accessible legal information tools.
problem_solved: Makes complex felony legal information accessible and understandable to the general public
why_valuable: Provides transparent, easy-to-understand legal reference material that helps people navigate complex criminal justice information
